runs.name: OGE Energy Corp.; NYSE OGE, Oklahoma, 10-K filer; holding company of Oklahoma Gas and Electric, a regulated electric utility in Oklahoma and western Arkansas
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order at the operator's word ("Yes start with those"), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, five analysts in parallel (NRG, OGE, PAM, PCG, PNW), lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **$48.41** (2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged) x **206,581,287 shares** (one class, Q2 2026 10-Q cover) = cap **$10,001M**; sovereign 5.33% (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-23). Q1 IN (one business since September 2022: OG&E, 88% of revenue under the Oklahoma commission, 7% Arkansas, 5% FERC; 10-K FY2025 `0001193125-26-055414`). Q2 IN on the regulated franchise, the regulator-set return carried to Q3; Oklahoma granted 10%, 18% and 38% of the last three increases asked and has held 9.5% on 53.5% equity since 2017; rural cooperatives contest service to new large loads; S&P negative outlook on wildfire. Q3 against; Q4 accounts clean, weighing against (guidance met at or near the top of the range three years running); Q5 integrity IN, ability undecided (bonus EPS target inside the published guidance, excluding the November 2025 shares); Q6 against (a 60% to 70% payout target while the business consumes outside capital; no buybacks). Q7 OUT on the floor: equity-only owner cash after maintenance $298.1M a year (2021 to 2025, midstream items removed, Uri cost and recovery both inside the window: CONVENTIONs of the run, confessed); negative after all spending in every year; the series changes sign so (b) leaves the no-growth case alone: range **$27.08 a share equity-only (central, regulated utility)**, literal window $24.77, all-equity $13.47; fair price **$14.43 equity-only** ($15.03 with the forward shares settled; all-equity -$6.03); the best excluded growth case is $32.59 at ten percent, still below the price. Peers (average ROE, own filings): OG&E 8.9%, EVRG 8.1%, SPS 9.2%, AEE 10.3%, XEL 10.4%, ETR 10.6%; OG&E earns below its allowed 9.5%. Tooling defects reported: `tools/run.py` leaves cost of removal out of capital spending and counts deferred credits in its debt table. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; seven pathspec commits, own paths only. Contamination declared: other runs' commit subjects, a `git status` file name, the names in the auto-loaded map; none opened. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: a one-state electric utility that never pays for its own growth (owner cash after all spending negative every year, filled with $1.9B of debt and new stock) while paying out about 70% of earnings, before a regulator that grants a minority of each ask. Range $27.08 equity-only vs $48.41, fair $14.43. Two more run.py defects: cost of removal left out of capex, deferred credits counted as debt.
